name: category
description: Enables or disables the specified category.

name: command
description: Enables or disables the specified command.

name: createembed
description: Converts the specified embed object into an embed.

name: defaultrole
description: Sets or disables the role that every member that joins the guild will get.

name: leavemessage
description: Sets the leave message that the bot will send every time that a member leaves.

name: logs
description: Sets the logs of the type given to the specified channel.

name: nick
description: Changes the nickname of the specified member to the nickname given.

name: permission
description: Gives or removes the bot permission given from the specified role.

name: prefix
description: Gets or changes the guild's prefix.

name: role
description: Gives or removes the role given from the specified member with the reason given.

name: setcooldown
description: Sets the given cooldown to the specified command.

name: temprole
description: Gives the role given to the specified member for the duration and reason given.

name: welcomeleavechannel
description: Sets the channel where the bot will send the welcome or leave message.

name: welcomemessage
description: Sets or disables the welcome message of the guild to the message given or disables it if a message wasn't specified, every member that joins the guild will receive this message.
